canvas_label: Canvas – drag to move, corners to scale, circle to rotate
empty_hint: Drop an image here, paste it (Ctrl+V) or click “Image” above
shortcuts: Tips: transparent areas are click-through · Alt+click = select the layer below · double-click text to edit · arrow keys nudge (Shift = 5 mm) · [ ] = send backward/forward · Ctrl+C/V copy/paste · Ctrl+Z/Y · Ctrl+D duplicate · Del delete · Ctrl+S save · Space + drag = pan
no_layers: No layers yet. Add an image, text or background.
select_hint: Select a layer to edit it.
lib_patterns_hint: A pattern is added as a background layer. You can change colours, size and angle afterwards.
lib_license: All shapes and patterns are original BeySkin works and free to use – also in shared links.
placeholder_note: Placeholder from a shared link – put your own picture here.
placeholders_export: The design still has empty image placeholders – they will not be printed.
lib_frames_hint: Round frames for gear chip stickers. You can change all colours (band, ring, lines) in the properties afterwards.
frame_center_hint: Otherwise the centre stays open for your picture underneath.
my_images_hint: Click to insert or drag straight onto the canvas.
image_in_use_confirm: This image is used in a design. Delete anyway? An empty placeholder will remain there.
transfer_confirm: This template already has a draft. Replace it with the transferred design?
copied_layer: Layer copied – paste it with Ctrl+V, also into other templates.
hide_outside_hint: Hide everything outside the cut line – shows only what ends up on the sticker.
